description: Helper functions for testing commit-graphs in a git environment. Contains functions to initialize OID cache, compare git modes, verify reproducibility of traversal operations, and read commit graph data.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Initializes the OID cache with versioned SHA1 and SHA256 identifiers.

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares the output of git command with commit-graph enabled and disabled to ensure consistency.

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Runs a series of git commands to verify consistent behavior with and without commit-graph across different branches and comparisons.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Prepares expected output and compares it with the actual output of reading the commit-graph data.
